title: Response by patient
subtitle: Response and drugs by study day, doses shown as {@doses}, drugs {@drugs}, [by {label(@parent)}]
script:
lv <- blockr.pharma::swimmer_drugs(data)
cutoff <- as.Date(NA)  #| date(label = "Cutoff", placeholder = "automatic")
pv <- blockr.pharma::swimmer_parameters(data)
parameter <- factor(pv[1], levels = pv)  #| select(label = "Response (ADRS PARAMCD)", multiple = TRUE)
drugs <- factor(lv, levels = lv)  #| select(label = "Drugs drawn")
doses <- factor("Gaps", levels = c("Gaps", "Plain"))  #| select(label = "Doses on the drug lines")
dose_tags <- FALSE  #| flag(label = "Tag dose changes")
reasons <- TRUE  #| flag(label = "Discontinuation reason where the drug lines stop")
con_meds <- FALSE  #| flag(label = "Con meds as lanes")
max_lanes <- 4  #| number(min = 1, max = 8, step = 1, label = "Lanes before \"Other\"")
events <- factor(c("Progression", "Death"), levels = c("Progression", "Serious AE", "Death"))  #| select(label = "Events")
blockr.pharma::swimmer_frame(data, doses = doses, dose_tags = dose_tags, drugs = drugs, cutoff = cutoff, con_meds = con_meds, max_lanes = max_lanes, events = events, reasons = reasons, parameter = parameter)
